title: The House of the Bell House
author: Tamsin Quintana
blurb: Ada Nakamura, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
